subject: Lumina AI / Brightline — marketplace listing & co-sell offer coordination
messages:
From: Evan Cheng <evan@lumina.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2024 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — listing Lumina CoPilot on AWS/GCP marketplaces + co-sell ask

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking a look. We're Lumina AI (ISV — real-time ML ops / copilots) and we'd like to get listed on AWS & GCP marketplaces and explore a co-sell path with Redwood. Two quick asks to start:

1) Can you share your typical evidence pack for marketplace private offers (billing SKU, metering docs, sample contract language)?
2) For joint demos, Brightline (our consultancy partner) wants a small pool of demo/POC credits and a co-sell contact to route opportunities.

I've attached a short questionnaire with technical and security bullets. Procurement may follow up with a contract/DocuSign.

Attachment: Lumina-Marketplace-Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Would you loop in the right listings / partner ops folks? Hoping to get an intake call next week.

Best,
Evan Cheng
Head of GTM, Lumina AI
evancheng@lumina.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cheng <evan@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Apr 2024 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — listing Lumina CoPilot on AWS/GCP marketplaces + co-sell ask

Evan — thanks, this looks promising. Quick outline of next steps from our side:

- I'll own the intake and product/commercial mapping.
- Ben (partner ops) will handle private-offer SKU mapping and co-sell entitlement flow.
- Priya (partner partnerships) will coordinate demo credits and the Brightline relationship.

Can you confirm the primary account region (US/EU) and whether Lumina will require a VPC or private control-plane for the listing? That affects the evidence set (SOC2 + DS encryption keys).

Action items for Lumina:
- Return the questionnaire (thanks for attaching).
- Share SOC2 summary or attestation if available.
- Indicate preferred marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure?).

I'll set a 30-min intake next Tue; proposing Tue 4/16 11am PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include Brightline.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
GTM — Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cheng <evan@lumina.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2024 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — listing Lumina CoPilot on AWS/GCP marketplaces + co-sell ask

Evan — looping in the ops details. A few specifics up front to help speed the intake:

- Marketplace coverage: we can support AWS & GCP Private Offers and Azure Managed Offers, but SKU mapping differs by cloud. Confirm target SKU naming convention and whether you want hourly vs committed pricing for POC/demo SKUs.
- Co-sell entitlements: we need a partner account alias to register Brightline as a solution partner in the co-sell flow (email/OrgID).
- Evidence: SOC2 summary is fine for initial intake; full report can be requested in later stages. Also include any data-residency / VPC requirements.

Internal note: if Lumina wants private control-plane or dedicated instances for demos, that will change the metering plan and potentially require a reserved commit — flagging to procurement.

I've attached a short checklist we use for private offers — it lists required metadata and DocuSign template fields. Once Lumina confirms region and SKUs I'll open the internal marketplace ticket and prepare the DocuSign.

Attachment (referenced): Lumina-Marketplace-Questionnaire.xlsx (sheet: billing+sku)

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@brightline.io>
To: Evan Cheng <evan@lumina.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — listing Lumina CoPilot on AWS/GCP marketplaces + co-sell ask

Hi all — Sofia from Brightline here (consultancy partner supporting Lumina). Thanks for pulling this together. A couple tactical asks from our side:

- Demo/POC credits: we request a pool of 50 demo hours (hourly SKU) scoped to a "Brightline / Lumina joint demo" tag so our AMs can run machines without hitting billing friction during workshops.
- Joint sales collateral: can Redwood share a short co-sell one-pager that we can co-brand?
- Logistics: we'll join the intake call; please include the proposed DocuSign timeline so we can align our SOWs.

On security, Lumina has indicated they prefer US-only data residency for the initial pilot. If Redwood needs a VPC or private link for co-sell demos, we can scope that in the SOW.

Sofia Ramos
Senior Partner Manager, Brightline Consulting
sofia@brightline.io | +1 212-555-0198

From: Evan Cheng <evan@lumina.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro — listing Lumina CoPilot on AWS/GCP marketplaces + co-sell ask

Thanks everyone — good sync. Confirming next steps and owners:

- Lumina to return the completed questionnaire and SOC2 summary (Evan / procurement@lumina.ai) — target: Wed 4/17 EOD.
- Redwood (Karthik + Ben) to open marketplace intake and prepare DocuSign + SKU mapping — target: Thu 4/18.
- Brightline (Sofia) to provide partner org alias and expected demo schedule so we can size demo-credit pool.
- Priya to draft a co-sell one-pager we can joint-marketing approve.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docusign.com/sign/LUM-PO-2345
HubSpot intake: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-67890

On the calendar: Karthik sent a 30-min intake for Tue 4/16 11:00am PT — we'll treat that as the working kickoff. If anything changes I'll update the invite.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to launching this pilot.

Best,
Evan Cheng
